kill_condition.rationale: Negative spot-price hours per year are reported in CAISO archived hourly market data + summarized in FERC Final Report on California Electricity Crisis (March 2003). Same ≥100-hour threshold as the Germany 2022 voice builds the §4 multi-event recognition bracket. Different fixture, different result is the phase-2 publication's intended structural shape.

verdict.rationale: Peak-year negative-spot-price hour count 12 (year 2001) < pre-committed threshold 100. Recognition criterion does NOT fire for either California 2000 or 2001 at this threshold. Per §4.3 reframe the voice does NOT pre-assert characterization; downstream synthesis describes what no-fire means against the documented crisis context. Honest read: the documented crisis behavior was dominated by extreme HIGH prices, not sustained negative prices — the recognition criterion looking for sustained excess-electricity correctly does not detect that opposite-direction substrate behavior.
